design_section: PROPOSAL: authenticated live shutdown handoff for genuine K68 (2026-10-09)
predecessor_attribution: final-controller stop of K68 runner, K68 resume, final-controller update
residual_limits: No persistent handoff, state/protocol schema change, new command, recovery permission or K68 patch.
A controller interruption or stop deadline discards live handoff authority; dead residual retries refuse.
Only unchanged sole control.sock may be unlinked after authenticated acknowledgement and unchanged terminal complete/all-processes-gone proof.
Claim release stays before socket cleanup. Late path/inventory refusal can release claims without marking stopped.
Same-UID serialization/trusted operator assumption retained; no hostile same-UID filesystem framework.
Source drafting only: no tests, CI, syntax, formatter, eval, builds, probes, processes or Git/index/ref operations launched.
G4/G6 incomplete campaigns and all private resources remain untouched.
source_basis: Genuine K68 can leave an authenticated lone control socket; its future scheduling and historical G4/G6 disappearance remain unproved. Final stop/update gain only current-invocation descriptor-backed retirement after complete exit.
